title: TUPLE-Bench: Evaluating and Mitigating Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in Typed Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed decision models often return more than a selected category. They also expose probabilities for each candidate and, sometimes, a separate confidence score. These fields support downstream decisions but may reveal information beyond a recipient's authorization. We introduce TUPLE-Bench (Typed decision models' Utility and Privacy Leakage Evaluation Benchmark), a benchmark of paired synthetic cases in which recipients may learn a coarse operational category but not its fine-grained cause. Across nine models, instructions to withhold the cause fail to protect it: 91.88%-99.93% of responses reveal the cause through direct selection or residual scores. Even when causes are excluded from the candidate set, full outputs enable 62.85%-75.35% recovery on held-out cases, compared with 51.04%-57.64% using only the selected category (50% chance). translated_title: TUPLE-Bench：评估与缓解类型化决策模型中的隐私-效用权衡
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型通常返回的不仅仅是一个选定的类别，它们还会暴露每个候选类别的概率，有时还会提供一个单独的置信度分数。这些字段可以支持下游决策，但可能泄露超出接收者授权范围的信息。我们提出了TUPLE-Bench（类型化决策模型的效用与隐私泄露评估基准），这是一个由成对合成案例组成的基准，其中接收者只应了解粗粒度的操作类别，而不应了解其细粒度的成因。在九个模型的测试中，要求隐藏成因的指令未能起到保护作用：91.88%-99.93%的回复通过直接选择或残余分数泄露了成因。即使将成因从候选集合中排除，完整输出在留出测试案例上仍能实现62.85%-75.35%的成因恢复率，而仅使用选定类别时为51.04%-57.64%（随机猜测为50%）。同时，在全部27个模型-任务对比中，完整输出均降低了平均下游成本。然而，置信……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TUPLE-Bench基准，系统量化了类型化决策模型中概率与置信度等额外输出带来的隐私泄露与决策效用之间的权衡，发现仅靠指令要求隐藏敏感成因几乎无效（泄露率达91.88%-99.93%），而完整输出虽在所有对比中降低下游成本，却使细粒度敏感成因的恢复率从约50%升至62.85%-75.35%。
en_tdlr: TUPLE-Bench systematically quantifies the privacy-utility trade-off in typed decision models, showing that instructions to withhold sensitive fine-grained causes fail (with 91.88%-99.93% leakage), and while full outputs consistently reduce downstream costs, they enable cause recovery rates of 62.85%-75.35% versus the 50% chance baseline.
